name: Civic works-record field guide

direction.thesis: A portfolio that routes a reviewer from inspectable public work to ten plainly marked WIP workflows. Refuse the dark bandit/reel shell, generic SaaS cards, and any visual that makes a source slice look like a completed job.
direction.own_world: Municipal works-order inspection-record grammar: cool-light ground, deep blue-charcoal text, one vermilion signal, system sans typography, labeled evidence/limit/handoff fields. Abstract the record structure; do not impersonate a government form or invent ticket data.
direction.story: The visitor sees two public case studies, then the ten in-progress workflows and their evidence boundaries, then the project résumé or GitHub contact. Source verification never stands in for job or AI verification.
direction.first_viewport: At 1440px, a compact header and 7/5 split: vermilion portfolio field with headline and inspection/résumé actions at left; divided dotz/Sophos proof and ten-WIP status index at right. At 390px, stack in that order without hiding links or status.

form.grammar: Municipal works-order inspection-tag; an evidence/navigation structure, not a municipal-service claim.
form.challengers: No named challenger wins both audience identification and truthful proof clarity; keep only useful disciplines, not their visual treatments.

direction.finish: unreviewed and undocumented is unfinished; this build ends with the finish review, the verdict, DESIGN.md, and every shipping raster carrying its provenance

typography.metadata: ui-monospace, "JetBrains Mono Nerd Font", "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace

geometry.layout: 12-column 7/5 split on wide viewports; ordered stack on phone

motion.reduced_motion: remove nonessential movement; keep all content visible

accessibility_claim: Design intent only; no WCAG conformance claim or independent accessibility result is included.
